passages.text: Oh that I could comfort myself against sorrow! My heart is faint within me.
passages.note: Sorrow that will not be comforted

passages.text: For the hurt of the daughter of my people, I am hurt. I mourn. Dismay has taken hold of me. Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then isn’t the health of the daughter of my people recovered? Oh that my head were waters, and my eyes a spring of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!
passages.note: Grieving others' suffering; longing for healing

passages.text: Yahweh says, “Don’t let the wise man glory in his wisdom. Don’t let the mighty man glory in his might. Don’t let the rich man glory in his riches. But let him who glories glory in this, that he has understanding, and knows me, that I am Yahweh who exercises loving kindness, justice, and righteousness, in the earth; for I delight in these things,” says Yahweh.
passages.note: Pride in wealth, strength and cleverness
